title: Orsen and the Asset
author: Isandro Quintana
blurb: Rosalind Ashgrove, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
